newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Pitman, N.J.

text.p: OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE
to be held Tuesday, August 26, 1997, for
BOROUGH OF PITMAN
County of Gloucester, New Jersey
General Obligation Bonds, Series of 1997
(Bank-Qualified)(Book-Entry Only)
DESCRIPTION
Dated: September 1, 1997
Interest Payment Dates: March 1 and September 1, commencing March 1, 1998
Form: Fully registered, book-entry only (DTC)
Denominations: $5,000 and integral multiples thereof Call Feature: Bonds maturing on and after September 1, 2006,
callable on and after September 1, 2005,
in whole or in part, at par
Bank-Qualified: Designated as qualified tax-
exempt obligations'' for
purposes of Internal Revenue Code Section
MATURITY SCHEDULE
Maturity Principal Maturity Principal
(September 1) Amount (September 1)Amount
(plus accrued interest from September 1, 1997)
BID SPECIFICATIONS
Submission. Sealed bids by 11:00 a.m., August 26, 1997, at Municipal Building, not less than $1,600,000 nor more than $1,000 cash premium in excess thereof, plus accrued
interest, specifying amount of Bonds the bidder will accept (the Bonds accepted to be the first to mature).
Interest Rates. Either single rate for all Bonds or individual rate for each maturity, expressed in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%, ascending only.
Form of Proposal. Only on prescribed Form of Proposal and in accordance with Official Invitation, each included within Preliminary Official Statement.
Bid Security. $32,000, certified, bank cashier's or
treasurer's check, payable to Borough, to be applied toward purchase of Bonds or retained as liquidated damages if bidders defaults.
Basis of Award. Lowest net interest cost (total interest dollars to be paid over the life of the Bonds, less any premium).
Additional Terms and Conditions of Sale. Set fort

Official Invitation, which shall be controlling in the event of any inconsistency herewith. The Borough reserves the rights to waive any minor errors or irregularities in form or content of any proposal and to reject all proposals.
RULE 15C2-12; INSURANCE; CLOSING

Compliance with SEC Rule 15c2-12. Preliminary Official Statement, dated August 19, 1997, deemed final in accordance with SEC Rule 15c2-12. Final Official Statements to be provided as required, subject to timely receipt of
information from successful bidder. Continuing Disclosure undertaking by Borough, as required by Rule15c2-12.

Insurance. At bidder's option and expense, if qualified. Delivery of Bonds. On or about September 10, 1997, subject to, inter alia, receipt from successful bidder of reoffering prices of any yield on the Bonds, and approval of legality of issuance thereof by Blank Rome Comisky &McCauley,
Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and Cherry Hill, New Jersey, Bond Counsel.
Copies of the Official Invitation and Preliminary Official
Statement may be obtained from Jay P. Todd,
Clerk/Administrator, Pitman Municipal Building, 110 South Broadway, Pitman, New Jersey 08071. Phone: (609) 589-3522.
(From The Bond Buyer)
